reviews.content: Wizards and in app things get impossible to read (dark text on dark background). Happens with most apps
It's my favorite mod on Windhawk. Works great.

Honestly my favorite windhawk mod, close second being taskbar auto-hide instant show. Ever since Rectify11 stopped development after the 24h2 release of Windows i've been looking for a solid replacement for it's modernization, mainly system-wide dark mode, of win32 elements. This fits that usecase perfectly and if you, the dev, are reading this: please don't stop improving on this. It's damn near perfect for me and I know i'm not the only one who has wanted something like this for years. You're doing a great job with this and i hope you don't get discouraged by negative reviews because you really do have something special here.
